info.title: Sound Server API
info.summary: One search API for free music samples: drums, 808s, loops, vocals, FX, foley and instruments, with licence verdicts.
info.description:
Search 35 sample sites at once (Freesound, Wikimedia Commons, Openverse, Internet Archive, ccMixter, BBC Sound Effects,
Kenney, Mixkit and more), get each sample's licence with a plain verdict on commercial use, preview it, and download the
original WAV/AIFF/FLAC with its credits. A free, non-commercial service: files always come from the source sites, never
from copies hosted here.

**Typical flow:** `GET /v1/search` → `GET /v1/samples/{id}` → `GET /v1/samples/{id}/download`. To assemble a drum kit
in one call, `POST /v1/kits`.

**Licence verdicts:** every sample's `license.verdict` answers "can this go into a commercially released track?": `yes` (commercial use ok), `yes-with-credit` (commercial use ok with credit), `restricted` (restricted: read the conditions), `clearance-required` (needs paid clearance per release), `check-terms` (unclear: check the terms), `no` (non-commercial only).
`commercial=true` keeps only `yes` and `yes-with-credit`. Verdicts are a summary, not legal advice: read the licence before releasing.

**Authentication:** the public server at sound.shep.bot is open. Self-hosted servers can require a key
(`SOUND_SERVER_API_KEY`); send it as `Authorization: Bearer <key>` or `x-api-key: <key>`. Keys are accepted in headers
only, never in the URL, so they stay out of logs, browser history and Referer headers. Freesound originals need your own
Freesound token in `x-freesound-token`.

**For AI agents:** the same capabilities are exposed as MCP tools at `/mcp` (Streamable HTTP).
See [Use with coding agents](/docs/mcp).

**Rate limits:** 120 requests per minute per client on `/v1/*` and `/mcp`. Every response carries
`RateLimit-Policy` and `RateLimit` (IETF RateLimit header fields) plus `RateLimit-Limit`,
`RateLimit-Remaining` and `RateLimit-Reset`; a `429` adds `Retry-After` (seconds).

**Versioning:** the major version is in the path (`/v1`). Breaking changes only ship in a new major
version; deprecated endpoints announce themselves with `Deprecation` and `Sunset` headers at least
90 days ahead. See [Versioning & deprecation](/docs/api/versioning).

apiKey.description: Same key, as a header. Query parameters are not accepted.

RateLimit.description: Current quota, e.g. `"default";r=117;t=42` (r = requests remaining, t = seconds until reset).

RateLimit-Policy.description: Quota policy, e.g. `"default";q=120;w=60` (q = requests per window, w = window seconds).

RateLimit-Remaining.description: Requests left in the current window.

X-License.description: The sample's licence id and verdict, e.g. `CC-BY-4.0; verdict=yes-with-credit`.

X-Attribution.description: The credit line to publish with your track (ASCII), when the licence asks for one.

example.error: Rate limit exceeded: 120 requests per 60s. Retry after 12s.

Category.description: Dot-path category. A parent matches its children in filters (`drums` includes `drums.kick`). Top level: drums, bass, vocals, fx, foley, ambience, keys, guitar, synth, strings, brass, woodwind, mallets, other.

SampleForm.description: `one-shot` a single hit or note; `loop` loops seamlessly at a tempo; `phrase` a longer non-looping performance; `multisample` a playable instrument; `pack` a zip of many samples; `midi` a MIDI file; `preset` a synth preset.

CommercialVerdict.description: Can this go into a commercially released track? `yes` (commercial use ok), `yes-with-credit` (commercial use ok with credit), `restricted` (restricted: read the conditions), `clearance-required` (needs paid clearance per release), `check-terms` (unclear: check the terms), `no` (non-commercial only).

id.description: SPDX id where one exists (CC0-1.0, CC-BY-4.0, CC-BY-NC-4.0…), else `LicenseRef-*`.

redistribution.description: May the sample itself be passed on (in a pack, repo or dataset)? Almost always false.

assertedBy.description: `source`: recorded per item by the site; `site`: one licence for the whole site; `uploader`: claimed by an anonymous uploader and not verified (capped at `check-terms`).

note.description: One line on why the verdict is what it is.

url.description: The sample's page on the source site.

categoryEvidence.description: How the category was decided: by the `source`, the `file` name, word `rules` or a `model`, and how sure (0..1).

unit.description: One sound, a pack of many, or a playable instrument.

packSize.description: Number of sounds when `unit` is pack or instrument.

rootNote.description: MIDI note of a pitched one-shot (60 = C4).

previewUrl.description: Always-playable lower quality file (MP3/OGG) for auditioning.

thumbnailUrl.description: Pack artwork or a waveform image.

formats.description: Known file formats: wav, aiff, flac, ogg, mp3, mid, zip…

attribution.description: Ready-to-paste credit line, when the licence asks for one.

requiresAccount.description: The full-quality file needs an account on the source site (e.g. Freesound originals).

downloadable.description: True when this server can fetch the files directly.

popularity.description: Downloads or plays on the source, when published.

sameAs.description: Ids of the same sound on other sources.

format.description: Lowercase extension: wav, aiff, flac, ogg, mp3, zip, mid…

requiresAuth.description: Needs a login, a purchase or your own token on the source site.

shareUrl.description: Web page for people: opens this sample in the search app and unfurls in chat apps with a preview card.

SampleFilters.description: The filters in force after parsing the query (explicit parameters win over words in `q`).

status.description: `link` = the site forbids or blocks automated access; use `searchUrl` to run the same search there. `skipped` says why in `error`.

searchUrl.description: The same search on the source website.

filteredLocally.description: Filters this source could not apply itself; the server applied them to the page it returned, so it may hold fewer results than `limit`.

query.description: The free text left after BPM, key and form words were parsed out.

results.description: Merged and ranked; a sound mirrored by several sources appears once.

access.description: `api` official API; `static` a curated manifest filtered locally; `scrape` public pages; `link` deep links only (the site forbids or blocks automated access).

apiKeyEnv.description: Environment variable holding the source's API key on a self-hosted server.

nativeFilters.description: Filters the source applies itself; the rest are applied locally.

style.description: Genre or character words added to every slot's search.

slots.description: Slot names: category ids (`drums.kick`), short ids (`hat.closed`) or words (`crash`, `perc`, `riser`, `vocal chop`). Default: kick, snare, clap, hat.closed, hat.open, 808.

key.description: Key for pitched slots (808, bass, synth), e.g. "F minor" or "F#m".

commercialOnly.description: Only picks whose verdict is `yes` or `yes-with-credit`.

KitSample.description: A short summary of a sample picked for a kit; `GET /v1/samples/{id}` has the rest.

preview.description: Playable URL (through this server's CORS-enabled preview proxy).

reason.description: Why this pick won, or why the slot is empty.

name.description: Short kit id (from the style); also the Strudel bank name.

licences.description: Number of picks per licence verdict.

creditsNeeded.description: True when any pick must be credited.

credits.description: The credit lines to publish with your track.

gm.description: General MIDI drum mapping (kick 36, snare 38, clap 39, closed hat 42, open hat 46, 808 on 35) and an SFZ file for any SFZ sampler.

get.description: Fans out to every enabled source in parallel (each with its own timeout), then merges and ranks. Words like `140 bpm`, `F minor` or `one shot` in `q` become filters (see `filters` in the response); explicit parameters win. Unknown BPM, key, form or duration stay in the list, ranked below known matches, unless `strict=true`. A slow or failing source never fails the search: it shows up in `providers` with its status.

parameters.description: Short query, written like a producer would.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Comma-separated categories; a parent includes its children. Top level: drums, bass, vocals, fx, foley, ambience, keys, guitar, synth, strings, brass, woodwind, mallets, other; children like `drums.kick`, `bass.808`, `vocals.chop`, `fx.riser`.

parameters.description: Comma-separated forms: one-shot, loop, phrase, multisample, pack, midi, preset.

parameters.name: bpm
parameters.description: Tempo or range: "140" or "120-128".

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: Musical key: "F minor", "F#m", "Eb", "A major".

parameters.name: max_duration
parameters.description: Maximum length in seconds (e.g. 2 for one-shots).

parameters.description: Only samples whose licence verdict is `yes` or `yes-with-credit`.

parameters.name: free
parameters.description: Only free samples.

parameters.name: strict

parameters.description: Max results (default 24).

parameters.name: x-freesound-token
parameters.description: Optional: your own Freesound OAuth2 access token. Freesound serves its original WAV/AIFF/FLAC files only to a logged-in user, so without it Freesound samples download as their high-quality MP3/OGG preview. The token is passed to Freesound for this request only and is never logged or stored.

get.description: One plain file redirects (302) to the source, so the bytes never pass through this server. Several files, files the source only serves with extra request headers, or `bundle=true` stream as one zip with `ATTRIBUTION.md` and `credits.json` next to the audio. `X-License` and `X-Attribution` carry the licence on both. Samples that are only available on the source site (an account, a purchase, a login wall) answer 409 with the page `url`.

parameters.name: role

get.description: Redirects (302) to the sample's preview. Previews the source only serves with a Referer, and any preview with `proxy=1`, are streamed through this server with `Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *`, so browser players, Strudel and web DAWs can load them. Previews only, at most 25 MB: this is not a general proxy.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Sample id `<provider>:<nativeId>`, URL-encoded (`:` may stay as is). Take it from a search result.

parameters.name: proxy
parameters.description: Stream the preview through this server (CORS enabled) instead of redirecting.

parameters.name: x-freesound-token
parameters.description: Optional: your own Freesound OAuth2 access token. Freesound serves its original WAV/AIFF/FLAC files only to a logged-in user, so without it Freesound samples download as their high-quality MP3/OGG preview. The token is passed to Freesound for this request only and is never logged or stored.

302.description: Redirect to the preview on the source.

404.description: Unknown sample, or it has no preview.

post.description: One search per slot (default kick, snare, clap, closed hat, open hat, 808), steered by `style`, `bpm` and `key`, returning the best pick per slot with alternatives and the reason it won. Commercial-safe picks only unless `commercialOnly: false`. The response includes a Strudel sample map and snippet that play the picks through this server's preview proxy, a General MIDI / SFZ drum map, how many picks fall under each licence verdict, and the credit lines.

parameters.name: x-freesound-token
parameters.description: Optional: your own Freesound OAuth2 access token. Freesound serves its original WAV/AIFF/FLAC files only to a logged-in user, so without it Freesound samples download as their high-quality MP3/OGG preview. The token is passed to Freesound for this request only and is never logged or stored.

get.description: Every sample site with the categories it carries, pricing, licence, the filters it applies itself and whether files can be downloaded directly.

How many samples every source holds, counted once a day: listings per source, by top-level category, licence and the source's own categories, free counts, listings added in the last 30 days, and highlights such as the most downloaded sample. `atLeast: true` marks lower bounds (sources that cap their counts). Sources whose count failed today keep their last good numbers with `stale`. The same file is at `/catalog.json`; one point per day is in `/catalog-history.json`.

404.description: The census has not been built on this server.

get.description: Aggregate usage of this server: searches by surface (web, API, MCP), downloads, MCP tool calls, the client families and categories searched most, and per-source health (success rate, p50/p95 latency). Counts come from Prometheus (`source: prometheus`, last 24 hours and 7 days) or, when it is unavailable, from this process since it started (`source: process`). No queries, IPs or user agents are exposed. Cached for 60 seconds.

post.description: Stateless Model Context Protocol endpoint for AI agents. Tools: `search_samples`, `get_sample`, `build_kit`, `find_similar`, `list_sources` (and `download_sample` on local installs, which saves files with their credits). Point any MCP client at this URL; see /docs/mcp for per-client setup.
